# halfExtents

## Summary

Returns a component's half extents `[hx, hy, hz]` from its authored dimensions, scale, and rotation — the spec-side equivalent of a Box3. It starts from `localHalfExtents` and, when the part is rotated, rotates the box's eight corners through the XYZ Euler triple and takes the widest reach per axis, so a wheel (a cylinder turned 90°) measures its true height rather than its unrotated one. Primitives whose extents are ambiguous return `undefined` and must be left alone rather than guessed at.

## Import

```ts
import { halfExtents } from '../util/spec-geometry';
```

## Usage

Used throughout `util/spec-passes/` (`overlap.gts`, `attachments.gts`, `placement.gts`) for constraint checks, and by `specBox` in this module to build the component's world axis-aligned box.
